set.body:
Purpose

Make mesh4s the single lawful topology and basic geometry kernel beneath ScalaFIM surfaces. ScalaFIM retains neuroimaging ingestion, scientific policy, world transforms, atlases, sampling, workflows, and renderer integration.

Current evidence, 2026-08-24

- mesh4s revision dfcb87507a53f73c42a38af5b0fc27b4029774dc cross-builds for JVM and Scala.js. It has no released binary artifact, so initial consumption uses an immutable sbt source ProjectRef.
- The former image4s/locus baseline blocker is resolved: surfaceJVM/test passes 115/115 and surfaceJS/test passes 90/90, including the generated 10,449-vertex and 20,480-face Scala.js GIFTI fixture.
- The active ScalaFIM worktree still contains the GIFTI Scala.js slice and a build.sbt edit. Preserve or land that work before overlapping integration edits.

Ownership boundary

- mesh4s owns TriangleTopology, vertex/edge/face/halfedge domains, incidence, topology audits, SurfaceRealization, intrinsic metrics, and optional graph projections.
- locus4s owns fields, regions, selections, sections, labels, and typed maps over the exact mesh vertex owner.
- ScalaFIM owns GIFTI and FreeSurfer ingestion, hemisphere and SurfaceKind, surfaceToWorld and RAS+ behavior, volume/surface sampling, atlases, scene/workflow policy, picking contracts, and cached renderer renditions.
- Ingestion constructs the typed surface model and a local packed renderer rendition. Do not invent a portable mesh byte format.
- Do not retain a second topology identity or adjacency authority. Compatibility digests and renderer buffers are derived views, not owners.

Execution slices

S0. Dependency and source-build alignment

- Select and publish one immutable locus4s revision containing indexAtValidatedOrdinal and every API currently required by ScalaFIM, image4s, and mesh4s.
- Pin that exact locus4s revision across the ecosystem. ScalaFIM currently pins af063d7 while mesh4s pins 4aa95b5; do not rely on classpath ordering between incompatible source builds.
- Add a pinned scalafim.mesh4s.build override and JVM/JS ProjectRefs for mesh4s-core. Add mesh4s-geometry only when S2 begins and mesh4s-graph4s only when its projection replaces a real consumer.
- Propagate coordinated local overrides for locus4s, graph4s, and spatial4s. Graph4s already shares revision ea5d2d7.
- Exit: one selected locus4s implementation is present on the surface classpath; JVM and JS surface baselines remain green with no functional API change.

S1. Strict topology compatibility facade

- Refactor TriangleMesh into a temporary ScalaFIM facade containing one mesh4s TriangleTopology while preserving current VertexId, FaceId, vertex, face, coordinate, and face-index compatibility where needed.
- Replace MeshTopology adjacency construction with delegation to the mesh4s owner. No second persistent edge or neighbor representation.
- Add typed Either constructors that retain TopologyAudit witnesses. Legacy throwing constructors may remain as thin compatibility wrappers.
- Default to strict construction. An orientation-repair policy must be explicit and retain the mesh4s flipped-face receipt; never silently flip or drop cells.
- Correct the inconsistent tetrahedron and spherical winding fixtures. Replace the bow-tie open-fragmented fixture and folded-star nonmanifold vertex fixture with lawful meshes; preserve explicit rejection tests for the invalid witnesses.
- Exit: topology, incidence, components, boundaries, Euler characteristic, and neighbor traversal are mesh4s-backed on JVM and JS with the existing public facade still usable.

S2. One topology with multiple realizations

- Build one canonical topology per surface set, then attach white, pial, inflated, spherical, and other coordinates as SurfaceRealization values over that exact owner.
- At GIFTI/FreeSurfer ingress, validate independent triangle tables against the canonical ordered connectivity before attaching coordinates; structural comparison is an ingestion operation, not ordinary equality.
- Define the spatial4s frame policy explicitly. Preserve ScalaFIM surfaceToWorld and RAS+ transformation behavior rather than conflating the realization frame with world space.
- Prove the vertical slice through one strict or explicitly oriented GIFTI/FreeSurfer asset plus the generated fsaverage5-scale Scala.js fixture.
- Exit: owner identity, not repeated face-array comparison, proves that all coordinate realizations and vertex data belong to the same topology.

S3. Packed renderer rendition and performance

- Create one renderer-local packed coordinate/index rendition from the canonical model at ingestion or compile time. Reuse it across frames and backends.
- Do not call PointField.interleavedDoubles or reconstruct face arrays per frame; those public exports allocate.
- Preserve SurfaceCompiler, SurfaceLayer, backend upload, picking, and RAS+ contracts. Keep SurfaceWorldLink.nearestVertex acceleration as a separately tracked performance item.
- Measure JVM allocation, Scala.js topology-construction time and peak memory, FullOpt output, renderer upload counts, and bundle-size impact on the 10,449/20,480 fixture and a representative cortical surface.
- An upstream borrowed-buffer or copy-into API is optional and must be justified by these receipts; it is not an integration prerequisite.

S4. Exact locus4s surface data ownership

- Make topology.vertices the finite-domain authority used by SurfaceLocusDomain.
- Migrate full and sparse SurfaceField, SurfaceRoi, labels, regions, selections, sections, and vertex mappings to locus4s data structures while retaining narrow ScalaFIM facades where downstream compatibility warrants them.
- Add compile-time and runtime owner-mismatch courts. Equal vertex counts or equal fingerprints never authorize cross-owner indexing.
- Treat the existing 16-character MeshTopologyIdentity as a legacy compatibility digest only. Use the mesh4s owner and connectivity fingerprint as the new authority, and version SurfaceScene/atlas-derived identities before changing serialized keys.
- Exit: there is one vertex-domain owner and no ordinal-only field can silently attach to another surface.

S5. Edge, graph, and numerical policy cleanup

- Resolve edge-order semantics explicitly. ScalaFIM currently sorts endpoint pairs while mesh4s uses first face-major occurrence. Migrate positional Seq[Double] weights to a typed field over topology.edges or provide a checked compatibility permutation; never reinterpret existing sequences silently.
- Use one explicitly named mesh4s graph projection where graph4s interop is needed.
- Rename the current Geodesic mode to an honest edge-graph shortest-path name. Continuous surface geodesics are outside this epic.
- Keep vertex-normal weighting as a named ScalaFIM policy until a separately justified upstream abstraction exists.
- Exit: graph correspondence and edge-weight ownership are typed and deterministic, with no hidden order changes.

S6. Cross-platform and downstream release court

- Run focused JVM and Scala.js suites after every slice, then testAll and testFullOptJS.
- Run affected downstream surface-view, Three.js, raster, spatial, atlas, and mvpa-spatial gates on both platforms where cross-built.
- Add adversarial topology fixtures for orientation conflict, duplicate face, nonmanifold edge, nonmanifold vertex, unused vertex, disconnected lawful components, open boundaries, and malformed ingestion.
- Prove scene/atlas compatibility or a versioned migration, exact topology sharing across coordinate kinds, field-owner rejection, packed rendition reuse, and unchanged picking/world-coordinate behavior.
- Require warning-clean compilation and document the final module and ownership boundary.

Non-goals

- Scala.js GIFTI enablement itself; that reader is already implemented and green.
- A portable mesh serialization or browser byte protocol.
- A generic property-bag mesh, arbitrary cell complex, continuous geodesic, FEM, DEC, or curvature subsystem.
- Hiding invalid topology through permissive fallback.
- Rewriting every ScalaFIM surface API in the first slice.
- Requiring Maven publication before source-pinned integration.

Epic acceptance

- One mesh4s TriangleTopology owns every surface cell domain and is shared by all realizations in a SurfaceSet.
- Invalid topology fails closed with concrete typed witnesses; any orientation repair is explicit and auditable.
- MeshTopology and SurfaceLocusDomain no longer maintain parallel adjacency or vertex-domain authorities.
- Edge weights, fields, labels, and mappings are attached to exact typed domains rather than positional coincidence.
- Renderer packing is a derived cached rendition with no per-frame full-mesh export.
- Existing scene, atlas, sampling, picking, and RAS+ behavior is preserved or changed through an explicitly versioned contract.
- JVM, Scala.js, FullOpt, downstream, allocation, and realistic-ingestion gates are green.

Related tracking

Companion mesh4s integration bead: bd-01KYT3BJ7ZGKTWEY00FMN572DW. This epic supersedes its former 88-error baseline blocker with the current green receipts above.
